The petitioner filed a writ petition in the Travancore High
Court against Respondent No. 1 and Respondent No. 2 (Indian In-come-Tax Investigation Commission) for a writ of prohibition or
any other writ prohibiting the Respondents from holding an enquiry

the Travancore Commission had under Travancore Act XIV of 1124

parties appealed to the Supreme Court against the order of the High

anything as authorised official which was not authorised by law or
was violative of the fundamental rights of the petitioner as in the
present case he would be amenable to the jurisdiction of the High
Court under Art. 226 of the Constitution.

Section 47( 1) of the Travancore Act XXIII of 1!21 was directed
only against those persons concerning \Vhom definite information
came into the possession of the Income-tax Officer an<l in conse-quence of which the Income-tax Officer discovered that the income
of those persons had escaped or been under-assessed or assessse<l at

On the other hand under s. 5(1) of the Travancore Act XIV of

-of payment of taxation on income made during the war period and

discriminatory in comparison with s. 47(1) of the Travancore Act
XXIII of 1121.
